detail.longDescription: I'm building an AI agent that runs fully on-device on Android. Deliberate limits: no cloud, no root or system-level access, nothing that can delete, pay or send on its own. The question I keep circling back to: what does such an agent have to do to be actually useful, not a demo? Curious what the local-first / privacy crowd would want from it - or whether "safe" here just means "pointless". # LocalLLM # OnDeviceAI # AndroidDev # Privacy # FOSS # AIAgents
